name: Squadron Hawk
description: A small bird creature from Magic 2011 that can be gathered in numbers and used as flyers, chump blockers or food for other creatures.

description_citations.work: Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk
description_citations.text: "Slime, Trials, and the Inner Garruk". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Aug 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The columnist drafts three Squadron Hawks for his tournament deck.
timeline.quote: By a stroke of luck, I drafted three of them for my tournament deck, which was pretty sweet.
